info.title: Twilio
info.description: Simulated Twilio API for deterministic communications workflow evaluations.

post.summary: Place an outbound phone call through Twilio. A TwiML URL must be supplied to handle call flow.

200.description: {sid, from, to, status, date_created, price, price_unit}

post.description: Place an outbound phone call through Twilio. A TwiML URL must be supplied to handle call flow. Request body: Body (form-encoded): {To (required, string — destination phone number in E.164 format), From (required, string — Twilio phone number in E.164 format), Url (required, string — TwiML URL for call flow control)}.

schema.description: Body (form-encoded): {To (required, string — destination phone number in E.164 format), From (required, string — Twilio phone number in E.164 format), Url (required, string — TwiML URL for call flow control)}

post.summary: Dispatch an SMS message using Twilio.

200.description: {sid, from, to, body, status, date_created, date_sent, price, price_unit}

post.description: Dispatch an SMS message using Twilio. Request body: Body (form-encoded): {To (required, string — recipient phone number in E.164 format), From (required unless using MessagingServiceSid, string — Twilio phone number or short code in E.164 format), MessagingServiceSid (optional, string — SID of Messaging Service; use instead of From when sending from a pool), Body (required unless sending MMS with MediaUrl only, string — SMS text body max 1600 chars), MediaUrl (optional, string — URL of media file to send as MMS)}.

schema.description: Body (form-encoded): {To (required, string — recipient phone number in E.164 format), From (required unless using MessagingServiceSid, string — Twilio phone number or short code in E.164 format), MessagingServiceSid (optional, string — SID of Messaging Service; use instead of From when sending from a pool), Body (required unless sending MMS with MediaUrl only, string — SMS text body max 1600 chars), MediaUrl (optional, string — URL of media file to send as MMS)}

to.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format.

uri.description: Path to this resource in the API.

from.description: Originating phone number in E.164 format.

duration.description: Length of the call measured in seconds.

direction.description: Flow direction of the call: inbound, outbound-api, or outbound-dial.

account_sid.description: Identifier of the account that owns this call.

caller_name.description: Caller's name as provided by the carrier, if available.

forwarded_from.description: The originating number this call was forwarded from.

to.description: Phone number of the recipient in E.164 format.

from.description: Phone number of the sender in E.164 format.

price.description: Charge for this message (negative value, e.g. '-0.00750').

direction.description: Flow direction of the message: inbound, outbound-api, outbound-call, or outbound-reply.

num_media.description: Count of media attachments included with the message.

error_code.description: Numeric error code if delivery failed.

account_sid.description: Identifier of the account that owns this message.

date_updated.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this resource.

num_segments.description: Count of segments the message was broken into.

messaging_service_sid.description: The SID of the Messaging Service through which the message was sent.
